title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Unknown/Reserved Error Code Handling Work Item
summary: Add server-side STOP_SENDING dispatch prevention, client-side unsolicited RESET_STREAM tolerance, and registered error code pathway documentation.
planned_changes:
- Add STOP_SENDING check in DoqServer.HandleQueryStreamAsync after reading query but before handler dispatch.
- Add MaxUnsolicitedResets property and atomic counter to DoqClient; count peer RESET_STREAM events and close connection only when threshold exceeded.
- Add doc comment to DoqErrorCode noting the registered-specific-code MAY pathway.
- Add focused tests: STOP_SENDING before dispatch, unsolicited RESET_STREAM below and beyond limit, and registered code documentation.
verification_plan: Run DoQ stream lifecycle tests, DoQ fatal protocol error tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Broad reset accounting beyond unsolicited RESET_STREAM behavior on the client.
DNS padding, EDNS(0) handling, internal error code rewriting.
completion_notes: All three REQs are now traced and verified. The DoQ server stops processing on STOP_SENDING, the client tolerates configurable unsolicited resets, and the registered error code pathway is documented.
